rules: Classify work before choosing Direct Maintenance, Direct SDD, Architecture Discovery, or Patterned Harness.
Keep product truth in the owning Python contract; renderer and desktop surfaces consume typed projections.
Reusable work lands on public main before private downstream integration.
Every compatibility bridge has one owner, retirement condition, and negative oracle.
Run focused owner evidence before an affected or release closure.
Keep credentials, raw subprocess output, source bodies, and private paths out of portable evidence.
